text: DP-700 is Microsoft's associate-level exam for the Fabric Data Engineer role. It validates exactly the Fabric skills from Course 3 of this track — Lakehouses, Warehouses, Eventstreams, KQL, notebooks, and the pipelines that connect them.

Scoring is reported on a one-to-a-thousand scale, with a passing threshold set around seven hundred. The exam mixes standalone questions with case studies — shared scenarios followed by several questions about them.
Standalone questions test one fact at a time. Case studies give you a scenario, then ask several questions about it — the style you'll drill starting in Lesson 31.

This chapter doesn't teach anything new — it reviews what Courses 1 through 3 already covered, organized the way Microsoft organizes the exam. Lesson-number citations point back to where each concept was actually taught.
DP-700 assumes hands-on Fabric experience, not a prerequisite exam. Next up: the exam's three official domains and how much each is worth.
